title: Sprawling US Winter Storm Strains Power Grids, Snarls Travel
summary: A sprawling US winter storm stretching from the southern Rocky Mountains to New England is straining power systems, leaving thousands without power, while threatening large amounts of snow and ice in some of the country’s most densely populated corridors, including Texas, New York and Boston.
